description: Pila de skills model-agnostic para experiencias web guiadas por scroll

skills.description: Fundamentos de scroll: narrativa, accesibilidad, performance, responsive, SEO, degradacion progresiva
skills.activation: when the user asks for scroll fundamentals, accessibility patterns, performance rules, or progressive enhancement for scroll experiences
skills.no_activation: CRUD apps, forms, dashboards, or tasks unrelated to scroll-driven web

skills.description: Direccion visual cinematografica: tokens, storyboard, capítulos, ritmo, continuidad, verificacion de calidad
skills.activation: when the user asks for cinematic scroll quality, design tokens, taste guardrails, choreography, or quality scoring
skills.no_activation: generic CRUD, basic landing pages without cinematic motion

skills.description: Orquesta experiencias web guiadas por scroll con estrategias model-agnostic: secuencia visual, escenas conectadas, video scrub, fallback estatico
skills.activation: when the user asks for a scroll-driven cinematic experience, scroll-scrub world, immersive landing page, or guided visual journey
skills.no_activation: CRUD apps, forms, CMS integrations, dashboards, API-only backends

ImageProvider.input: ImageRequest { prompt: string, aspectRatio?: string, resolution?: string }
ImageProvider.output: AssetResult { assetPath: string, format: string, sha256: string, metadata: MediaMetadata }

VideoProvider.input: VideoRequest { prompt: string, startImage?: string, endImage?: string, duration?: number }
VideoProvider.output: AssetResult { assetPath: string, format: string, sha256: string, metadata: MediaMetadata }

MediaInspector.output: MediaMetadata { width: number, height: number, duration?: number, codec?: string, fps?: number }

RuntimeVerifier.output: VerificationResult { passed: boolean, checks: Check[], score?: number }
